name: Clockwork Cadaver
subjectPrompt: A shambling humanoid shell clearly being moved like a marionette by its own internal tarnished brass frame. Stocky adult in a weathered moss gray northern wool tunic torn at one shoulder, sagging fabric and stiff sideways tilt. One dull human eye and one small dark lens at the temple. Brass finger rods and a few small toothed gears visible at seams where material has weathered, subtle retractable metal finger claws. Dry and non-graphic, no blood or open flesh. Figure has an improvised fragile appearance, not a suit of armor.

name: Clockwork Controller
subjectPrompt: An upright figure passing for a composed human court functionary. Tall and lean adult with human skin mostly intact, sober face, and faded storm blue fitted northern court coat and bronze fasteners. Subtle thin brass understructure glimpsed at the wrist beneath a lifted cuff. One eye holds a narrow pale crystalline glint suggesting an eye beam, and on one hand just the tips of elegant retractable mechanical claws show. Quiet precision with one hand lifted as if directing invisible troops. No long beams, armor suit, or gore.

name: Clockwork Queen
subjectPrompt: Regal imperious medium-sized automaton in her true form, entirely of bronze gears, springs and coils. A cruel and elegantly cast humanlike bronze face below a compact clockwork diadem, elegant built-in segmented skirt made of curved bronze strips, small blue, ruby and amber crystals shining through gaps in the brasswork. Delicate interlocking panels folded outward at the shoulders like remnants of a puzzle box. A small exposed whirling blade mechanism on one forearm. No cloth on the robot, no throne or setting.
